verbatim_locators.evidence_for: OPCs express TR alpha, not TR beta, mRNA (rodent, optic nerve OPC cultures)
verbatim_locators.quote: Moreover, we find that OPCs do not express TRbeta1 or TRbeta2 mRNAs, whereas they do express TRalpha1 and TRalpha2 mRNAs.

verbatim_locators.evidence_for: TR beta null does not change optic nerve oligodendrocyte number
